entries.back_en: "Pardon my presumption, but I believe you are the God Emperor ...Yes?"
"Pardon my presumption, but I believe you are the God Emperor ...Yes?"
"Thou sayest thou wert waiting for us? Thou knowest of us and what we are then?"
"Yes, Your Majesty. You are the first Emperor, [name], who founded our great Fou Empire."
"You appear tired, Majesty. It is to be expected, I suppose-- you have just awoken from a long, long sleep, and you are not exactly...complete, are you?"
"I wouldst call thee foolish... But thou art mortal. Thou cannot go against thy nature, no more than a fish could walk upon the firmament."
"Alas, it is as you say, my lord. For now, we would have you sleep once more."
